title: MR spectroscopy
description: An MR spectroscopy analyzes the chemical composition of tissue to detect disease at a molecular level. This specialized outpatient MRI provides information about tissue metabolism and biochemistry, going beyond standard structure imaging. It's particularly useful for evaluating brain tumors, neurological disorders, or muscle disease. You lie still in the MRI scanner for 30-60 minutes while specialized sequences are acquired. The procedure is painless and non-invasive. Results guide diagnosis and treatment planning. You go home immediately with no recovery time.
